title: PR209 sealed release binding interfaces (internal implementation specification)
description: No authority is granted by this document. Exact sources perform additional byte, chronology, set-equality, DOI and payload checks. All fixture evidence is synthetic.

path.description: Case-relative POSIX path; basename only where explicitly stated. No traversal, empty/dot components, backslashes or symlinks.

utc.description: Machine UTC with zero offset, no future timestamp.

reviewEntry.description: Assessment and manifest are sibling ASSESSMENT.json/AUTHORED_MANIFEST.json. Every manifest payload is read and hashed. Helper source_freeze is required and sealed. Findings require resolution. Supplemental payloads are additive, preserve every original payload, and bind the original manifest.

publicExportManifest.description: Paths are case-relative. Cleared c.public_export_manifest pin must name publication/PUBLIC_EXPORT_MANIFEST.json. Unique exact pins, no self/FINAL_CLEARANCE/mutable receipts/private/cache/env files. .gitignore is the sole permitted hidden basename. Extra top-level preprint/publication files outside source/admin names stop release.

status.const: single append about to be attempted

trackerReadback.description: Retains the complete actual provider JSON; canonical requested range is checked separately from provider-normalized response.range.

trackerReceipt.description: Count1 requires exact append_result; count0 requires exact reconciliation_before and true reconciliation. Both require saved exact target cells and full after scan with exactly one problem/DOI row at the same canonical target.

release_helper_reviews.freeze: source_freeze actual FROZEN_SOURCES.json frozen_utc and rows, with exact sealed helper copies

clearance_contract.chronology: Each freeze < completion; next freeze > prior completion or later resolution UTC. Unique IDs in each chain. Final whole frozen_bindings equal exact current seven-core map, final helper frozen_sources equal exact current six helper pins.
clearance_contract.resolution: Actual pinned root record review_id (or reviewer), review_assessment_sha256, review_manifest_sha256, utc>=completion, all and only actual finding IDs with status=resolved, empty unresolved lists. Whole package_bindings must equal next frozen_bindings; helper source_bindings must equal next frozen_sources. Additive report supplement digest is linked where supplied.
clearance_contract.counters: fresh_manuscript_reviews equals actual whole chain length. final_frozen_clean_reviews equals exact-current no-finding whole reviews, >=1. Booleans rejected.

stage_intent.operation: single stage about to be attempted

publish_intent: operation=single publish about to be attempted
verified_receipt: lineage exact digest map of six prior records
resolved DOI to exact HTTPS zenodo.org version record
both actual retained public downloaded bytes with payload pins and matching URL/size/SHA256
publication_lineage.acyclic: No ancestor hashes the final verified receipt. Tracker hashes final publication, never vice versa. Public export manifest precedes clearance and excludes itself/clearance/later mutable records.
publication_lineage.unknown_outcome: Existing stage/publish intents prohibit repeat mutations; retained known-ID publication may recover by inspect/public download/DOI only.

api.context(root): Pure local, keeps existing CTX and binding keys. Checks actual review chains, source/helper/core pins, metadata/deposit pair and public export manifest.
api.publication(root,pub,ctx=None): Pure complete stored publication acceptance; requires retained lineage and downloaded payload bytes.
api.tracker(root,pub,ctx=None,z=None): Pure complete stored tracker acceptance; requires APPEND_ATTEMPT and actual retained readbacks.
api.public_exports(root,pub,ctx): Pure {case-relative-path: bytes} from only the cleared manifest; exact source/admin top-level guard.
api.expected_tracker_row(ctx,z): Exact four strings; title/version/publication_date derive from cleared metadata, source2004.12497v11, blank SolutionChatURL, actual DOI URL, reviewed theorem/credits/limitations notes.
api.verify_tracker_live(R,PUB,CTX,z): Import-safe append module function. Caller holds stage lock. Only GWS get reads for metadata, exact target and full A:D scan; saves private timestamped evidence and returns utc/binding/publication and tracker digests/target/values/evidence pins. Accepted receipts untouched.
api.verify_publication_live(R,PUB,CTX): Import-safe readonly module function. Caller holds stage lock. Pure receipt validation then inspect --check-doi and actual public byte downloads; returns utc/binding/publication digest/id/DOI/resolver/inspect pin/download records. Accepted receipts untouched.
api.append_once(R,PUB): Acquires shared lock; at most one append; existing uncertain outcome can reconcile exact unique existing row with append_count0.
api.publish_once(R,PUB,ROOT=None): Acquires shared lock; at most one stage/publish; calls readonly verifier after the once mutation.

scope_limits: Internal implementation, not independent source review or final clearance.
No live publication/tracker/native provider calls used by repair probes.
No proof of malicious coordinated rewriting of every trust anchor.
Final new independent source audit remains required.
